reviews.title: Missing Pawa
reviews.text: Very nice! great service, the flight is always on time and great drinks! great flight time and smooth ride every time I flew with them.
reviews.author: Kickin' It With Dee
reviews.route: St Martin / St Maarten - Santo Domingo

reviews.title: sorry that it was late
reviews.text: excwelent service, good food, service and very punctual, too bad is not traveling to Dominican Republic.
reviews.author: rparra667

reviews.title: What can I say... they are grounded
reviews.text: I booked 2 flights with PAWA months in advance and 3 months in between the two flights. The first one was cancelled so we had to pay triple the cost of the PAWA flight as we had to get there that day and by the time the second flight was coming up the airline was grounded. I guess that’s what I get for planning so far ahead! Obviously my advice is that even if this company does start flying again to not choose them! Save yourself the stress, agro and ultimately money!!!
reviews.author: Mullen89

reviews.title: PAWA DOMINICANA CANCELATIONS
reviews.text: The airline cancelled operations three days after I bought my ticket due to debt with Government of Santo Domingo. They indicated through the website and email that all customers should process their refunds and they would be responding in 21-30 business days. After one month, no response, no one to talk with about the situation, and no responsibility from anyone on reimbursement to our credit cards. If the company does not pay its clients back, they should not be allowed to fly under any circumstances, whether under PAWA or any other name for that matter. There should be a government agency to deal with this, but no one says me.;-((((
reviews.author: LNannette

reviews.title: Nightmare
reviews.text: I booked a ticket back in December and was called a month later telling me the airline would not operate flights on the day we choose and we were changed to a later date. I called and said that would not work and finally got confirmation of a change a day earlier. Now, today, I just got another notification that the airline will not operate any flights the week of my travel. I already had to change the hotel and car rental ones, and now to book with another airline I am going to pay upwards of $100 more than what I paid for my flight. What a nightmare. Worse airline and I haven't even flown with them yet. They need to figure out what they are going to do and stop screwing people over because they continue to cancel flights every other month.
reviews.author: wisconsindude2017

reviews.title: Never Reimbursed me for 3 tickets..
reviews.text: while I bought 3 tickets in advanced for 3 consecutive weekends (because I go to law school in DR). Airline was closed. I know have 3 tickets of 265 each, that has not been refunded. even after completing the online paper work requested. it has been over 40 days, and I still don't have my money in my credit card.
reviews.author: Humbeero Guzman

reviews.title: stranded in Miami
reviews.text: I have just had a terrible experience with this airline . they have gone into suspension on 29/01/2018 .No notifications to pax at all . I came to Miami from Austria to find out that my next flight with Pawa domenicana tu Curaçao will never happen. I found myself in a city where i have no one and hotels are so so expensive . All those costs and Pawa is most probably never gonna refund ticket judging from their very difficult form for refund . Does anyone have an advice what to do ? thanks
reviews.author: Nirvana Davina

reviews.title: Out of Business
reviews.text: This airline was a going concern for many years, but got caught up in a lot of problems both locally and abroad. Their communication to customers became extremely poor and lack of payment to vendors ultimately caused them to cease operations completely.
reviews.author: David R

reviews.title: Good Service
reviews.text: Very nice people, warm service on board. Not the first time I have flown with the airline, the seats on the plane are a little bit small, but they complement it with a very pleassing service.
reviews.author: mlopez52

reviews.title: Hope you never need to use this company
reviews.text: I had no option after hurricane Irma but to choose this airline: customer service answers only when you want to buy. When you need to change your flights, they don't know you anymore. Incredibly careless staff. I didn't use my ticket after the whole hurricane season, I did tell them, and no answer at all. If they knew I wasn't flying due to other flight's cancellation, why couldn't they refund? Most of airlines did it in consideration of the people that were affected by the hurricanes - this guys made money on all that people and that is ridiculous.
reviews.author: lantillais971

reviews.title: Very inexpensive tickets and good service
reviews.text: This was a round trip and the price paid was great for the service, they have full meal on their flights, on free check baggage and one carry on, and most important they were on time both ways.
reviews.author: Marcial G

reviews.title: Very irresponsible!!
reviews.text: My flight was on Dec 21 at 6:30 pm, but they called me the day before to inform my flight was re-escheduled to leave at 12:00 am, and I needed to be at the airport at 9:00 pm, which I did just to find out the counter was closed and no one was there, I waited until someone at Pawa office showed up and said to me and some others that arrived later, that the flight was not leaving that night and we were going to fly next day first flight in the morning and they sent me back to city in a taxi who was picking me up next day to take me to the airport. They said they tried to reached me, and could not reach me, which is not true as I had no missed calls to return, besides they reached me the day before without any problem... my guess is they never called. No meal or hotel was provided after this nightmare, also I found out that the flight which I was supposed to take at 6:30 pm, has landed in Miami as expected, so they had chosen me randomly after overbooking the flight to take me out of it. This is unacceptable. And to make the things worse, on my flight back this morning at 5:15, they had an add on their web page informing that no 2nd baggage is allowed, so I had to leave half of the things I bought here to be sent by cargo, to make sure the info was accurate, I called Pawa and they said the same that is on their web. And guess what, when I get to check in this morning, they took my carry on because it was overweighed, and the girl at the counter said that info at the web was not correct, that this restriction was no longer in place, how convenient, as I had to bill my carry on and paid 50 USD as a fee, besides the US$100.00 to send my second suitcase via cargo. The information you get on the web and on the telephone was one, and when I get to the airport it was another one, now, instead off spending 50 US for a second baggage, I had to spend 150.00, this is not acceptable. I hope not use this airline any longer.
reviews.author: CarmenTavarez

reviews.title: Do not book with this airline!!
reviews.text: We booked a 2-leg flight from Havana to St Maarten in June 2017 through lastminute.com. Then Hurricane Irma hit the Caribbean but we decided we would still make the trip if our accommodation was OK. In October, PAWA then decided it would cancel the 2nd leg of our flight (from the Dominican Republic to St Maarten) so we asked for a refund. We have spent the past two months chasing the refund through lastminute.com, to no avail. So, my advice is do not use lastminute.com to book flights and do not book anything with PAWA. We have lost 500 euros deposit on our accommodation in St Martin and over £428 paid for this flight.
reviews.author: Steve Riley-Snelling

reviews.title: Plane Left the day before our scheduled flight
reviews.text: AVOID AVOID AVOID We had confirmed with our travel agent that all flights were okay. Imagine our surprise when we arrived at the airport in Antigua in December 15 to catch our flight to only be told that the flight had been changed to December 14!! We called Pan Am World and they told us that they had tried to contact us and our travel agent - we spoke to our agent who received no such call. Luckily we were able to contact after hours emergency through our agent and booked a flight and were able to make our connection on st Maarten to Saba. Warning: do not buy your tickets directly from this airline and ALWAYS have cancellation insurance!!! Our travel agent has been working for the past 2 weeks to get our refund AVOID AVOID AVOID
reviews.author: BSAP

reviews.title: Flight cancelled by PAWA - but I was never notified! They won't refund airfare.
reviews.text: Last summer, my wife and I booked flight from Aruba to St. Martin in February 2018. About 2 months before the flight I went to website to get information about the flight, but PAWA website could "Not find my booking". I called. After a long time, I was given new booking number. Then I was told that PAWA had canceled my flight as they do not fly to St. Martin anymore. I WAS NEVER NOTIFIED??!? I was told I would get a refund in 2 to 5 business days if I send an email requesting it. I did. A couple of weeks later, I emailed again as I had heard NOTHING. Several days later, I called again. Again told that I would receive refund. Put on hold so rep could ask how long it would be for me to expect refund and he came back saying I would only receive a partial refund. WHAT! Said I would get an email, which I actually did. It said that I would get a refund of the taxes only. If i wanted to "keep the ticket open" I could apply it, AFTER DEDUCTING THE CANCELLATION PENALTY, to another flight. WHAT??!! Now, afterSEVERAL MORE DAYS, I calledd again. They again saya they will email me. THIS AIRLINE DOES NOT SEEM TO UNDERSTAND ANYTHING ABOUT CLIENT RELATIONS OR COMMUNICATION. To me they have been dishonest on several occasions. If they are not going to refund me, for legitimate or illegitimate reason then just tell me. WHY ARE THEY ALLOWED TO FLY TO THE USA? I WILL NEVER CONSIDER A FLIGHT WITH THEM AGAIN.
reviews.author: Chuck C

reviews.title: First & Last flight...never again 👎
reviews.text: Only if you want to loose your time and waist your money with an airline whose employees don't even know about customer service and respect, try this airline. In addition, there was no warranty that me & my bag would get to our destination on the reserved date.
reviews.author: Luis Rafael

reviews.title: DECEPTIVE PRACTICES!!! Beware. They owe me $900 and refuse to pay me.
reviews.text: I purchased 4 airline tickets from PAWA Dominicana on 4/19/17, totalling $884.37, using 2 different credit cards. In august 2017 I received an email from the airline advising that the flight time was changed from 6:30pm to 10:00am (over 8 hour time difference). We had to cancel the tickets due to the change in time. Since then, I have been trying to get my refund from the airline with no luck. They agreed to give me a refund on 9/6/17, but after numerous phone calls and emails, I never received my refund. I have emailed them everything they have requested - copies of ID's, passports, bank statements, copies of old credit cards, copies of new credit cards, but the more information I send in, the more they request. In December 2017 I sent them an email demanding my refund. I also advised that both credit cards are no longer valid, but they can go ahead and process the refund on the cards they have on file (per instructions from both banks), because both accounts are still valid, even though I have new card numbers. Now they are requesting letters from both banks stating the reason why both cards are no longer valid, with old and new credit card numbers, on company letterhead with a company stamp. After speaking with both banks, they said they have never heard of such a request, and they told me to have them process the refund on the old card. Both banks said they do not include credit card numbers on correspondence, and they advised me not to send them my new credit card info (even though I already had). The company refuses to process the refund on the old card, or the new card - because now they want a letter that does not exist. I begged both banks for the requested letter and one bank provided me with a letter - but the company still refuses to refund my money because they claim it does not have all the requirements in it. They say I have to follow their policy, but it seems like they are making things up as they go along. Their policy seems to interfere with US bank policies. I cannot afford to lose close to $900. My new credit card information is no business of this company. If I didnt tell them I got new cards, they would have processed the refund on my old cards and I would have my money by now. The problem is - they do not want to refund my money. They never tried to refund my money since my initial interactions with them in August, September, October, or November. I told them about my new cards in December, and now they are acting like it is my fault why I do not have my refund. I went in to speak with a manager at Bank of America and showed him all the correspondence between myself and the company. He advised that PAWA has no intentions of returning my money. It is too late to file a dispute with my bank. I need any and all the help I can get in this matter. This company should not be allowed to steal $900 from an innocent person. They already ruined our vaction by changing the flight time by so many hours. We had to cancel our trip, now they want to keep our money. Everytime I call this company I am paying international long distance, and they refuse to let me speak with a supevisor or manager. This is ridiculous!!
reviews.author: Alexandra C

reviews.title: Nice flight atendance and espacious seats; one bagge freeeeeeeeeee
reviews.text: It is a good new airlines; the check in was very quick and pleasure counter attendance as a nice/courteoous flight attendance with every one.
reviews.author: bcamejoreyes

reviews.title: Excellent trip to Dominican Republic
reviews.text: My trip to Sto Domingo for the 2017 Presidente Festival I flew with PAWA Dominicana. Flight attendants were very polite and service-oriented. The way they talk to each other may sound a bit rough but it's the way the complete population communicates. But towards customers you may notice that the staff is well-trained. The flight went very smooth and on my return to Curaçao the experience of flying with PAWA was the same. It means continuity in service level. Keep up the good job, PAWA Dominicana. You may be proud.
reviews.author: InServiceCur

reviews.title: Delightful surprise
reviews.text: We were hesitant to use this airline because we had never heard of it, but our flight on JetBlue was cancelled, so we had no choice. The short flight on PAWA couldn't have been better! The counter personnel and gate agents were friendly. The MD 82 was clean and uncrowded. The pleasant flight attendants served packets of chips and soft drinks during the 40-minute flight. The plane departed and landed on time. I would never hesitate to fly this airline again.
reviews.author: bajabirdy

reviews.title: This is the worse company to fly!
reviews.text: I just want to tell you honestly If you have any problem with this airline you will not find any contact. You just e mail they e mail back to you after 2 days with customer service below. You try to call, it rings but nobody picks up to calls. If plane has a problem they just tell you to keep waiting without explanation. Return flight was three hours late nobody explain anything, they did not even offer water or any snacks no apologize. The worst experience ever...Even if drop a dollar I never purchase any trip.
reviews.author: Ayk Y

reviews.title: Claim for unreported reprogramming, loss of flight and other effects on 07/30/2017
reviews.text: This is a copy of the emails sent. No one answered. oc.bluemall@pawadominicana.com 31 de julio de 2017, 11:21 calidad.servicio@pawadominicana.com 31 de julio de 2017, 18:11 Reservation code OOAIBZ The first inconvenience occurred with flight 7N 765, which instead of leaving SDQ at 15:30, left at 18:30. Mr. José de León from PAWA, who assisted me in SDQ, issued a voucher to my lunch. When asked if the return flight 7N 766 was according to the initial itinerary, he answered yes. When I arrived to Miami I had to take a taxi because my friends who were waiting for me with my family had to retire before so much delay. On July 30 at 15:00 when trying to do the Checkin for 7N 766 (departure time 20:00 in my bill), it turns out so that I can not do it because the flight had left. No one answered at the Miami office phone. Only by calling the office of Blue Mall in Santo Domingo, I get the answer that the approval to fly tomorrow July 31, will be given from 09:00, when I could have left on the flight of 06:15. In neither case did I receive any notice, phone call, or email. I had to cancel a work meeting for Monday at 10:30 with an important client of my company. And pay for transportation to the Miami airport from the PAWA office. I beg for a prompt response to this claim.
reviews.author: Ricardo J. Pérez Fernández

reviews.title: WORST AIRLINE EVERRRRRRR
reviews.text: Worst customer service in such a terrible circumstances. Had a trip Cuba/Dominican republic when hurricane Irma hit hard the island of Cuba, had to cancel my trip all together; my flights and Airbnb in both islands as hurricane Maria also caused damage in DR. My flights with Delta NYC-Habana and with JetBlue Santo Domingo/NYC were 100% reimbursed to me, Airbnb also reimbursed 100% , all based on natural disaster circumstances, but NOOOO pawa, I called the office in Santo Domingo and nobody pick up the phone, I called the office based in Florida and I spoke to a customer service rep who told me they can not cancel reservations that have to be dealt with the Santo Domingo office, I called back multiple time and stay in line for a prolong period of time but nobody picked up the phone. I sent an email and it was never reply. I will neverrrrrrrrrrrrrrr recommend to book with this airline.
reviews.author: JussepNYC

reviews.title: Excellent option for your money and time
reviews.text: Excellent option to fly directly to Havana, from Santo Domingo 2 Hour comfortable flight, where surprisingly you are served food and beverage for free in a short flight Service by all personnel is warm and professional Cost of the ticket, very competitive, lower than the rest of options Trully reccomend PAWA Dominicana Just one con.......planes little old and it shows, no tv,or entertainment, chairs and bathrooms need replacement Overall experience great and very related with the money paid
reviews.author: JMEA1

reviews.title: Right up there with the best ones.
reviews.text: I had the opportunity of using PAWA this past weekend and I was extremely impressed. The check in process was very smooth and fast. Even though SJU was packed it took me less than 10 mins to complete the check in process. The attendant was very knowledgeable and provided great advice. Multiple attendants at the counter. At the gate, the gentleman there was super nice and that process was not only timely but fast as well. The flight departed on time. Flight attendant rivals the best flight attendants out there. I am an executive platinum in one of the biggest airlines. Pawa service and customer care was better. Landed on time. Exiting the aircraft was super fast as well. These people for their stuff together. I am a PAWA client.
reviews.author: cjvillares

reviews.title: PAWA refunds!!!  Watch out!!!
reviews.text: I was supposed to travel on September 20th but the flight was cancelled after Hurricane Maria devastated the Island of Puerto Rico. A refund was requested but only after various attempts calling then email the airlines took 30 days to respond then said they will not refund the money. It is a nightmare trying to get a REAL person on the phone. There is no response other than an email that does not make sense. Horrible customer service and NO desire to resolve the situation.
reviews.author: dianaanglada2016

reviews.title: Worst airline EVER ..... NEVER book with them under any circumstances
reviews.text: This is one of the worst customer service centers I've ever encountered in decades of traveling. We were planning to fly with Pawa to Puerto Rico before the island was ravaged by hurricanes when we reached out to the airline to change our flight to a locations with running water and electricity we were told that was not an option under any circumstances. We told the representative that we would be willing to pay a change fee and they refused. They offered for a $80 chance fee we could fly to Puerto Rico the day before or after our booked flight. We again explained that the island had been devastated and we just wanted to go anywhere else with PAWA they again refused saying the airport in Puerto Rico was up and running and that is the only stimulation for continuing the flight. They said if it was a war ravaged country they would still send us there if the airport was up and running and that our personal safety made no difference to them. DO NOT BOOK WITH THIS AIRLINE!!
reviews.author: locknessa404

reviews.title: Terrible plane, very inflexible reservations
reviews.text: To begin with, the plane I flew on looked like it hadn't been updated or serviced since 1990. I called to try to reschedule my flight before hurricane Maria, and they would not change my reservation until the flight was canceled. They waited until several hours before the hurricane hit to cancel my flight, which caused an avoidable wait of a week and a half in Santo Domingo, trying to catch a flight back while each flight was successively canceled. They also would not just refund me the amount for the return flight.
reviews.author: Brandon B

reviews.title: Still good
reviews.text: I have flew with Pawa about 8 times and it used to be perfect and on time. Good snack and drinks. Nice and friendly crew. Last trip got delayed for 2 hours with no excuse, but tbe staff was so nice and the captain excused later. The flight back was very good so I gave them 5 for this, but should consider inform the customers often and while waiting. Show respect.
reviews.author: Jose A

reviews.title: Worst customer service experience, EVER. THE WORST.
reviews.text: I don't even know where to begin! We booked a one way flight from MIA to SXM some months ago via JustFly.com (also a horrible experience). Our flight was for October 29th, 2017. With the recent hurricane (IRMA) completely destroying the beautiful island of St Martin (SXM), it has become completely uninhabitable for tourists. There are no hotels, no airbnbs, and the locals are telling us to stay away at least until 2018. Our other flights, hotel, and 2 airbnb's have refunded us in full without any questions (even with strict policies) because THE ISLAND IS UNINHABITABLE. It is NOT safe to go there right now - especially for little kids. This is where the horrible service comes in. PAWA is not willing to cancel the flight and give our family a refund. Their only option? Pay $240 (we paid about $540 total) to let us change the flight from now until March 2018 (6 months). My family only gets full vacations once every 2-3 years!!! They obviously A) don't care at all about the safety of their customers, B) have no idea what happened in one of their destinations (SXM), and C) don't care to do the right thing while everyone else has. This is absolutely unacceptable if you ask me. They still have time to do the right thing, but for now this is the absolute WORST experience I've had with an airline, EVER.
reviews.author: Kilay R

reviews.title: Fairly good
reviews.text: This was my first flight with this airline. I found the seating arrangement comfortable and the staff friendly and courteous. It was a chartered flight so i am not sure if that would make a difference. The return flight was just as smooth as the first.
reviews.author: Lionel L

reviews.title: If there is no other option
reviews.text: If you are forces to fly PAWA, then be prepared... Travelled from Curaçao to St. Maarten on their MD-80. This plane is PACKED with seats. I would say to its full capacity. There is no leg space, and I am short, seats are narrow and the connection in Santo is a nightmare. No clear instructions. No one knows where to go, unless you already flew once with them. Its a mess by the gate and I guess I was lucky to get the one empkoyee with the worse ethics when I approached him, asking what I am supposed to do next. After a complaint, I got a very nice gentleman, well mannered, that was willing to assist. Overall, you get where you have to get and fairly on time but the experience is not great.
reviews.author: Jeanthal

reviews.title: First Time...Last Time
reviews.text: Well we must always adjust our expectation when traveling to another country however know this before you book. We searched for tickets to Santos Domingo and these were just a little lower then carriers we are familiar with. So we booked and this is what you need to know: 1. You cannot check in on line it must be in person 2. You cannot pick your seat prior you do it when you check in 3. Some of the plans are really...no really old like ash trays in the arm rest 4. They are sticklers for the bag carry on limit...if you have 3 passengers with three bags that are below the acceptable you will need to pull stuff out of bags that are over and move to less full bags. 5. Staff is friendly on plane but some do not speak English...not a real issue 6. Drinks are limited beer or rum...hey you are in the DR not a problem but you should know you will not get your favorite drink. I think the biggest issue is having to arrive early to check in and the age of planes.
reviews.author: Eddie V

reviews.title: Need a lot of improvment
reviews.text: Had no other choice of airline to fly to Santo Domingo on our recent family trip. This airline needs a lot improvement in terms of cleanliness, quality, ground staff customer service and quality of onboard announcements.
reviews.author: SXM-Rick
reviews.route: St Martin / St Maarten - Santo Domingo

reviews.title: Horrific Experience!!!!
reviews.text: If I could commence this review with a 0 I would! I originally had my flight purchased for my husband and I since May. With that being said, this airline company changed my flight and failed to notify me. I found out when I arrived at the airport at 3:30 AM that the flight would be leaving at 2:30 PM!! I found this to be ridiculous. When I called Corporate Offices in Santo Domingo they advised they indeed had two phone numbers and emails (at which point they confirmed with me and they were correct) yet, they had no proof of communications with me. When I left on Monday, the service on the flight back was just as bad. They attended "VIP" passengers with drinks and food before a pregnant women and three children whom were flying alone. When I asked for coffee they advised I needed to wait yet the "VIP" passenger got their food and drinks on demand. At that point they didn't even offer my husband and I food until we complained that they had skipped us. When I advised I had filed a complaint and that this would be the 2nd complaint, they wanted to treat us like we should have been treated from the start. I filed two complaints and have yet to hear from them. AVOID THIS AIRLINE!!
reviews.author: Stephany L

reviews.title: Good for the price
reviews.text: The flight from San Juan to Santo Domingo great. They were on time , they even offer free snacks and a drink. The flight returning horrible one hour delay sitting inside the plane with no a/c . They don't offer any kind of reward for the extended delay. Not due to any imperfections they were waiting for passengers to reach.
reviews.author: Enid K

reviews.title: My advice, chose another airline!!
reviews.text: Where do I start with PAWA Dominica? I don't usually leave back feedback but this had to be noted so no one else makes the same mistake my family and I did. First off no one speaks English. I departed from Miami and from the time I reached check in no one spoke English. 2nd, they insisted they could not find my connecting ticket nor returning flight. The airlines doesn't allow you to book one way flights and if my detonation is aruba, why would I be staying in Santo Domingo. 3rd, they stopped at several countries for "drop offs". But instead of staying on the flight we had to exit the place, stay at the airport in Curaçao, and board the plane again. Not a good experience. The only good thing is that I'm glad to be alive and the actual flight was a headache. Apparently there was a bomb threat which is a reason why the place was diverted so many times. In addition when information was given, English speaking folks were told 1 time and Spanish speaking folks were told another thing including the time. My advice, chose another airline!!
reviews.author: covia14

reviews.title: PAWA
reviews.text: Nobody is able to check in online in advance at least not today anyways. I called the phone numbers provided. Some just beeped and hung up, so after some research, I called the number for Miami and waited on hold for one hour without speaking to anyone. After the hour went by, an automated voice proceeded to tell me that I could enter my phone number and a PAWA representative would call me back. Six hours later and no phone call. I also e-mails and still nothing. I am frustrated already and have not even gotten to the airport. I called Expedia and had to speak to a manager to finally have someone help me and the manager was able to get in touch with a representative, who informed him that nobody can check in on-line. I at first thought it was because I booked my ticket through Expedia. He said it's everyone that wants to check-in, not just if purchased through Expedia. The PAWA agent was not able to check us in over the phone. We have to do it at the counter. Our flight is at 6:15. We aren't checking a bag so that we can sleep a litter later before our 3 hour drive tonight to get to the airport. At this point, we should just check a bag. The agent said the check-in starts at 3AM and the earlier you arrive, the better. Gulp.
reviews.author: sue7124

reviews.title: trip to miami
reviews.text: In April 2017 we took the flight to miami, quiet atmosphere and very good attentions during the trip, good food and drinks, reasonably priced and first bag included
reviews.author: pablo v

reviews.title: Phone customer service
reviews.text: I've trying to change my flight but been stuck on hold for 40 mins and call gets disconnected. I think they are the worst customer ever. You can't even do the change online. Sent an email to see if I get a response, but after reading all the reviews here, I don't think I would get an answer. I feel like I'm going to loose my money.
reviews.author: Anibal H

reviews.title: Vuelo cancelado SIN reembolso - Flight canceled, NO REFUND
reviews.text: I made in April a reservation for a flight to me made in September from Miami to Havana (round-trip) Some time after that, Pawa decided to cancel that route/flight and gave me NO alternative but to cancel the flight (and receive a full refund). The problem is that one month has passed since they offered FULL REFUND and NO REFUND was issued. I have to book another flight and have no way of doing it because Pawa doesn't issue the refund! I CANNOT WAIT ANY LONGER for the refund, but Pawa just DOES NOT CARE. Really bad !
reviews.author: PortugueseMiamiCuba

reviews.title: Disaster!!!!!
reviews.text: What a disaster! If I could give it a zero rating, I would. Flight out of Aruba on Friday delayed an hour - almost missed connecting flight to San Juan. When we arrived in San Juan, no bags and had to search for help. We finally found an uninterested agent who filled out a form and told us our bags would be delivered to our hotel on Sunday. We asked if they could get to us sooner as we only had one change of clothes and limited toiletries. The answer was no without any offer to assist. We were given a number to call to contact airlines about our bags.....beware of any phone number they give you....read on.... Saturday I spent the day in San Juan calling every number I could find. My calls were either unanswered or I spent over an hour waiting due to "high call volume" and them was disconnected without talking to anyone (I did this twice). The one time I talked to a "real" person, he gave me the same number to call that I just had dialed when calling. Sunday morning - still no bags and no one available to contact. Did I mention we leave for a one week cruise on Sunday at 1 p.m.? Looks like we will be shopping to try to replace neccesities so we can enjoy our cruise. Hopefully this true story has a happy ending but I am not holding my breath. PAWA sucks in customer service!

reviews.title: Price may be tempting but DO NOT book with PAWA - you will regret it!
reviews.text: We traveled with PAWA 6/18/2017 to St Martin and back to Miami on 6/25/2017. We were supposed to leave at 6:15am on 6/19 (we are early birds and like to fly out early to fully enjoy our 1st day of vacation). A couple days before our departure, PAWA cancelled the 6:15am flight and put us in a 2:30pm flight. Expedia, whom we bought the flight from kindly flew us out the day before so we could take advantage of the day. On the return trip to Mia, we we had a 1hr layover in Santo Domingo. Two days before our return flight, we receive an email stating that the connection flight was cancelled and that we would have a 7 hour layover in Santo Domingo instead of a 1 hour layover. The planes are old, dirty, musty smelling and the A/C is bad. The chairs are made of clothe and you can see tears and dust in betweeen the fabric threads. They look like 30-40 year old former American Airlines planes. No inflight entertainment what so ever. I regret not following the advice of my fellow TripAdvisor travelers. Shouldn't have booked with PAWA!
